I have completed the independent review of Hypothesis 2 (`h2_v2`) against [REVIEW_CONTRACT.md](file:///home/leechuck/Documents/papers/empty-quarter-mags/reviews/darkmatter-2026-10-13/round6/REVIEW_CONTRACT.md) and written the required outputs to:

- [review.txt](file:///home/leechuck/Documents/papers/empty-quarter-mags/reviews/darkmatter-2026-10-13/round6/h2_review1/review.txt) (1,499 words)
- [verdicts.json](file:///home/leechuck/Documents/papers/empty-quarter-mags/reviews/darkmatter-2026-10-13/round6/h2_review1/verdicts.json)

### Summary of Findings & Verdict

- **Resolved from v1:** [01_select_cohort.py](file:///home/leechuck/Documents/papers/empty-quarter-mags/reviews/darkmatter-2026-10-13/round6/snapshots/h2_v2/scripts/01_select_cohort.py#L137-L228) now consistently uses `bin_to_species.get(b, "")` and excludes blank species across both admission and analysis, and [02_extract_neighbourhoods.py](file:///home/leechuck/Documents/papers/empty-quarter-mags/reviews/darkmatter-2026-10-13/round6/snapshots/h2_v2/scripts/02_extract_neighbourhoods.py#L324) keys Bakta CDSs by `(normalize_contig(r_contig), start, stop, strand)`.
- **Critical Issues Requiring Repair (`C1`–`C5`):**
  1. **Primary KO aggregation & callability ([03_analyse_conservation.py](file:///home/leechuck/Documents/papers/empty-quarter-mags/reviews/darkmatter-2026-10-13/round6/snapshots/h2_v2/scripts/03_analyse_conservation.py#L103-L174), [pilot_family_conservation.tsv](file:///home/leechuck/Documents/papers/empty-quarter-mags/reviews/darkmatter-2026-10-13/round6/snapshots/h2_v2/results/pilot_family_conservation.tsv)):** `ko_by_sp_primary` aggregates KOs from any non-truncated flank of a primary locus before checking locus completeness (`is_complete`), contaminating 7/24 reported primary-conserved families (4 with impossible $R_{\text{fam}} > 1.0$, 1 inflated species count, and 2 false-positive `QnotK` calls that shift $\Delta$ from $-0.2708$, Fisher $p = 0.0581$ to $-0.1875$, $p = 0.1778$). Furthermore, `source_file_unavailable` and `coordinate_mismatch` flanks are treated as `is_complete = True` and `has_any_callable = True` (affecting 97/185 non-edge primary loci; only 88 loci have all 4 flanks mapped in Bakta, yielding $N = 27$ families, $K = 9/18$ vs. $Q \setminus K = 5/9$, Fisher $p = 1.000$), while 164/272 `coordinate_mismatch` flanks on IBEX share the exact 3' stop codon and strand with a Bakta CDS (61 carrying KEGG KOs).
  2. **Broken `contig_len == 0` tie-breaker, broken GTDB-Tk join, and non-converged logistic regression ([01_select_cohort.py](file:///home/leechuck/Documents/papers/empty-quarter-mags/reviews/darkmatter-2026-10-13/round6/snapshots/h2_v2/scripts/01_select_cohort.py#L32-L93), [03_analyse_conservation.py](file:///home/leechuck/Documents/papers/empty-quarter-mags/reviews/darkmatter-2026-10-13/round6/snapshots/h2_v2/scripts/03_analyse_conservation.py#L316-L353), [pilot_conservation_summary.json](file:///home/leechuck/Documents/papers/empty-quarter-mags/reviews/darkmatter-2026-10-13/round6/snapshots/h2_v2/results/pilot_conservation_summary.json#L56-L131)):** Column 2 of `contig_to_bin_refined.tsv.gz` is `"refined"`, so `contig_len == 0` for all 534/534 rows in [pilot_members.tsv](file:///home/leechuck/Documents/papers/empty-quarter-mags/reviews/darkmatter-2026-10-13/round6/snapshots/h2_v2/results/pilot_members.tsv). Reading unrefined `02_taxonomy/gtdbtk_out/` instead of `05_refine/_gtdbtk_refined/` and `05_refine/_gtdbtk_r232/` leaves 532/534 pilot member rows without taxonomy and 99/100 pilot families as `phylum = "unassigned"`, causing quasi-complete separation on `phylum_unassigned` (55 vs. 1; $\text{SE} = 424{,}697.1$) and non-convergence (`"converged": false`), which [DOSSIER.md](file:///home/leechuck/Documents/papers/empty-quarter-mags/reviews/darkmatter-2026-10-13/round6/snapshots/h2_v2/DOSSIER.md#L120-L131) omits.
  3. **Permutation null conditioning & between-arm test statistic ([03_analyse_conservation.py](file:///home/leechuck/Documents/papers/empty-quarter-mags/reviews/darkmatter-2026-10-13/round6/snapshots/h2_v2/scripts/03_analyse_conservation.py#L262-L299)):** The null loops over all 212 primary loci (including 53 edge-truncated loci), draws edge-truncated positions in 33.5% of draws (`b = 0`), and compares $\Delta^{\text{obs}} = -0.2708$ against the difference of low-prevalence random-position rates ($\sim 12.5\%$ vs. $10.1\%$, shrinking the Bernoulli SD from `0.1336` to `0.0681` and yielding an artifactual $p = 0.0010$).
  4. **Contig mapping, silent missing-bin attrition, and `DYNAMIC` inputs ([02_extract_neighbourhoods.py](file:///home/leechuck/Documents/papers/empty-quarter-mags/reviews/darkmatter-2026-10-13/round6/snapshots/h2_v2/scripts/02_extract_neighbourhoods.py#L235-L281), [INPUTS.tsv](file:///home/leechuck/Documents/papers/empty-quarter-mags/reviews/darkmatter-2026-10-13/round6/snapshots/h2_v2/INPUTS.tsv#L14-L17)):** 209/293 available pilot bins contain duplicate contig lengths (29,760 contigs), 14/307 unique bins lack Bakta files on IBEX and silently return `{}`, and per-sample/per-bin inputs remain `DYNAMIC`.
  5. **90%-cluster representative basis & residual prose ([01_prep.sh](file:///home/leechuck/Documents/papers/empty-quarter-mags/reproducibility/darkmatter/upstream_code/04_structure/00_structure_clean/scripts/01_prep.sh#L19-L20), [04_cluster.sh](file:///home/leechuck/Documents/papers/empty-quarter-mags/reproducibility/darkmatter/upstream_code/04_structure/00_structure_clean/scripts/04_cluster.sh#L6-L9), [darkclean_5_mag.sh](file:///home/leechuck/Documents/papers/empty-quarter-mags/reproducibility/darkmatter/upstream_code/04_protein_catalog/darkmatter_clean/scripts/darkclean_5_mag.sh#L73-L101), [DOSSIER.md](file:///home/leechuck/Documents/papers/empty-quarter-mags/reviews/darkmatter-2026-10-13/round6/snapshots/h2_v2/DOSSIER.md#L3)):** Document whether membership conditions on the 90%-cluster representatives in `04_cluster/clusters.tsv` or expands via `all_cluster90.tsv`, and remove remaining `"candidate novel folds"` and `"operons"` claims.

**Verdict:** **REVISE**
